message: 世界は救われたかのように

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmh... nn... Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you call?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel... Azel...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel!! You're safe!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Quiet. Don't raise your voice. There are others sleeping.」

name: Azel
message: 「It was a close call... However, this man turned out to be quite the contrarian.」

name: Azel
message: 「Even after I drilled it into him so much to just trust me... Honestly, to think he'd shatter the barrier and jump right in.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President...!? You're so battered and torn up--what on earth happened?」

name: Azel
message: 「Your lover saved me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whaaaat!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Virus was obsessed with a one-on-one duel, you see. He seemed displeased about us fighting together, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「There was no need to play fair with the likes of him.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pfft, heehee... For an angel, you can be pretty underhanded too, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Heh, I suppose so.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so glad... that you're safe, Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Virus has been sent back to the Demon World. There is nothing to worry about anymore.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm really... so glad... *sniff*...」

name: Azel
message: 「H-Hey. Why are you crying? There's nothing to be sad about!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee... You're wrong, these are tears of joy.」

name: Azel
message: 「Tears... of joy...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tears don't only fall when you're sad--they also flow when something makes you happy」

name: Azel
message: 「I see... So you're... happy that I'm safe...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course I am♪」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is that so...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I am very upset that you knocked me out and acted so recklessly」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh. A-About that, I made it back safely, so... let's call it even, shall we?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No! This calls for a proper punishment... I sentence you to tickling--\s07」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop it----」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-Azel... san?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It seems the battle with the Virus has left me exhausted as well」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-You're right! Please don't push yourself, and get plenty of rest today」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much, Azel-san」

name: Azel
message: 「The thanks are mine. Thank you for staying by my side」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly... It's unfair of you to get a head start like that, President!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, you helped save Azel-san... You really are a wonderful President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so glad... that you were by my side, President... Truly...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But I can't keep relying on you forever, President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「About Azel-san... about the angels... and about Re-Crea too...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no! If I let myself get down, the President will just end up comforting me again!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President... please get some good rest for now... *mwah*\s04」
